name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An AI research assistant that reads Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, and more to tell you what's really being said about any person, company, or topic right now.
buyer: A B2B sales rep who wants a sharp, current briefing on a prospect before a call instead of a stale LinkedIn skim.
business_use_cases: A sales team gets an automatic pre-call brief on a prospect's company: recent news, hiring signals, and what people are saying about them online.
A journalist or YouTuber gets a same-day synthesis of everything happening on a breaking topic across social platforms.
A brand manager tracks real-time public sentiment about their company across Reddit and X instead of paying for enterprise social-listening software.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a "pre-meeting research brief" subscription to sales teams, delivered automatically before every calendar call.
Offer one-off deep-research reports on a company or topic for a flat fee.

steal_this: Build a Slack bot this weekend that posts a research brief on every meeting attendee an hour before the call, then sell it to a sales team as a $30/seat/month add-on.
